name: pitwall
description: A local, Markdown-first knowledge base for agents: hybrid search, linked projects and resources, a review ledger and an orchestration skill

kb_dir.title: Knowledge base folder
kb_dir.description: Folder of Markdown notes that pitwall indexes and serves. Run init_kb once to fill an empty folder with the starter layout.

server_url.title: Shared server URL
server_url.description: Optional. URL of a running pitwall daemon, for example http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp. Sessions then share one process instead of starting their own.
